effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

changes.historical_text: Tribute 2 monsters on your side of the field, including this card, to Special Summon 1 "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's s.spop finds no "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" in hand or Deck it reveals both zones to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. No lineage version carries reveal wording.

changes.historical_text: Tribute 2 monsters on your side of the field, including this card, to Special Summon 1 "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.sptg returns true unconditionally where the modern script requires Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,...), so the effect can be activated - paying the cost of Tributing this card plus one other monster - with no "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" to Special Summon. Nothing in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline text matches lineage v0 (FET-EN006, Flaming Eternity, 2005-03-01) exactly - the card's first printing, in force at the GOAT snapshot. Trailing lineage is cosmetic: v1 (DR3-EN126, 2006-11-25) restates "Tribute 2 monsters ... including this card" as "Tribute this card and 1 other monster" (the same two Tributes, and the cost function is unchanged between the scripts); v2 (CP04-EN018, 2007-09-06) adds the explicit "You can", which the effect already was - both scripts register it as an optional Ignition effect; v3 (DT06-EN010, 2012-02-03) is the PSCT semicolon. Only the LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK vs + spelling differs beyond the two ruling edits. Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
